scope: Expose pending group count and block full Data replacement until the user removes pending group sources on the form; preserve append and undo

newCases: pendingGroupCount requires a nonnegative safe integer and reaches router/Data
replace blocked by pending count or source lock independently
blocked multi-section turn returns no partial patch and preserves OCR
append allowed with pending groups; replace allowed after groups removed
live renderer rejects successful replace response before any field mutation
blocked replacement preserves name, direct rows and group sources across save/reopen
append and undo preserve group sources
manual group removal enables replacement; save/reopen contains only the new recipient and no pending groups

limitations: Service tests use AI/DB fixtures; Electron tests use the real renderer with fixture IPC/stores.
No production campaign was created or run.
Agent does not remove pending group sources itself; the user removes them using existing form controls before requesting a full replacement.
